descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Tsukasa Silhouette' Rare Tsukasa Silhouette Columnar Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Acer palmatum ‘Tsukasa Silhouette’ is an exciting new columnar Japanese maple that brings big fall colors to even small garden spaces. Tsukasa Silhouette was introduced in Japan by Yutaka Tanaka. In 2008, our good friend and nurserymen legend, Don Shadow named this selection in the United States. The first word of the name (Tsukasa) for the nursery of its origin and second word (Silhouette) describing the amazing slender shape. ‘Tsukasa Silhouette’ leafs out in the early spring with a bright chartreuse green display. By mid-summer, this heat tolerant Japanese maple selection has rich deep green foliage. This slim and slender columnar Tsukasa Silhouette Japanese maple tree has excellent autumn colors with ranges of orange to bright red. ‘Tsukasa Silhouette’ is most famous for its great shape. This form can reach 15-20 ft by only 6-7 ft in width in 20 years. This column of color and foliage is ideal for gardens with small spaces but it works equally as well in large gardens as an interesting accent plant. Add ‘Tsukasa Silhouette’ to your garden for a great heat tolerant Japanese maple that makes a brilliant fall display with a unique narrow form.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Tsukasa Silhouette' 稀有柱形日本枫，适生分区 5-9。 Acer palmatum 'Tsukasa Silhouette' 是一个令人兴奋的新型柱形日本枫，即使在小型庭园空间中也能带来强烈的秋色表现。 'Tsukasa Silhouette' 由 Yutaka Tanaka 在日本推出。 2008 年，我们的好友、苗圃界传奇人物 Don Shadow 在美国为该品种命名。 名称第一部分“Tsukasa”取自其原始育成苗圃，第二部分“Silhouette”则描述其惊人的狭长树形。 该品种早春展叶时呈明亮的黄绿色；至仲夏，这一耐热的日本枫品种叶色转为浓深绿色。 其纤细修长的柱形树姿在秋季具有极佳的叶色表现，可由橙色转为鲜红色。 'Tsukasa Silhouette' 最著名之处在于其优异的树形。 20 年可达 15-20 英尺高，而冠幅仅 6-7 英尺。 这种色彩与叶幕形成的“柱体”非常适合小空间庭园，在大型花园中也同样适合作为富有趣味的点景植物。 若想为庭园增添一个耐热、秋色绚丽且株形狭窄独特的日本枫品种，'Tsukasa Silhouette' 是很好的选择。
